newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to reveal Sept BOP data at 1700 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to reveal Sept BOP data at 1700 GMT.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank will reveal September balance of payments data at 1500 local/1700 GMT, a spokeswoman said.
The bank will announce the current account deficit, which in the first eight months reached 2.81 percent of gross domestic product. It will also reveal the level of foreign reserves.

In September, Brazil posted a $655 million trade deficit. Altamir Lopes, head of the Central Bank's economic department, said last month he expected the current account gap to end 1996 at about 3.0 percent of GDP.
